review.notes: Full re-review at 373b4c5. Previous findings: R01, C01-C07 and N01 repaired; R02 deferred as D01, which stands. Seeded sample read: 1.1, 1.3, 1.4, 1.5, 2.4, 2.6, 3.3, 3.5, 4.6, 5.2, 5.7, 5.11, 6.1, 7.3, 7.4. Of these, only 3.5 carries source locators (Kho99 Props 9, 27), which were checked; the rest were checked against the pinned Tau Ceti and Mathlib declarations. 25 locators were checked against Kho99, Bar02, Bar04, Jac02 and Kho02. The automatic checks all passed, and the dependency check reports 0 problems. Suggested.lean elaborates with five sorry warnings only, and #check of its 8 declarations matches the README. T(2,m) for m=2..7, the figure-eight, the trefoils, the Hopf links and the kink were recomputed with an independent integral calculator. New findings: the Künneth sequence and cycle splittings, and K-flatness, K-projectivity and the augmentation quasi-isomorphism, are already at the pins but are planned here (R01, R03); §6.1 plans certificate infrastructure (R02).
